source_of_truth.active_host_inventory: Supabase public.bigo_sources returned live by the BIGO live pipeline source-registry endpoint on every capture cycle; no fixed host count.
source_of_truth.merge_policy: Deduplicate the live active-registry host IDs with optional BIGO_HOST_IDS and BIGO_VERIFIED_HOST_IDS environment/Actions-secret additions; preserve registry source URLs and use the canonical room URL only as a fallback.
source_of_truth.allowlist_semantics: BIGO_VERIFIED_HOST_IDS is included in the capture inventory; it does not replace active source-registry checks or per-host rights evidence.

capture_method_configured.method: Resolve the complete host inventory from the live source registry; capture through the token-aware Streamlink BIGO resolver and HLS reader; normalize and QA media; upload processed video and cover to R2 first with S3 and public-CDN SHA-256 read-back; use Vercel Blob only if R2 upload/read-back fails; optionally archive to Dropbox and sync Drive. This is configured behavior, not proof of a successful production run.

public_capture_authentication.method: Public BIGO metadata and stream discovery with token-aware Streamlink, canonical-page HLS, identity-matched /sid/ and direct FFmpeg HLS fallbacks.

capture_method_configured.egress_proxy: Optional BIGO_EGRESS_PROXY GitHub Actions secret; used only for BIGO playback-token, HLS and CDN requests.
capture_method_configured.credential_storage: Keep Dropbox OAuth credentials and any optional BIGO session cookie in GitHub Actions encrypted secrets; never store their values in Dropbox manifests or this config.
capture_method_configured.storage: Cloudflare R2 is configured as primary public delivery; Vercel Blob is a per-object fallback; Dropbox is optional secondary archival; Google Drive is optional secondary sync. R2 production read-back remains unverified.

capture_status_policy.media_verified: The selected provider's upload and public HTTPS read-back matched the local SHA-256 and byte count; R2 also requires S3 object read-back.
capture_status_policy.blob_verified: Vercel Blob upload completed and public GET read-back matched the local SHA-256 and byte count
capture_status_policy.captured_not_published: Media is provider-verified and ingested, but downstream publication is not confirmed or is held by policy
capture_status_policy.published_verified: Downstream platform returns a publication identifier or URL and the post is read back/verified
capture_status_policy.failed_or_offline: Record per-host outcome and continue processing other hosts
